hook.say: Six centuries of Ottoman history in five questions. Most people get the last one wrong!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: Mehmed the Conqueror was only 21 years old.
questions.sayAnswer: Mehmed the Second! Known as the Conqueror, he was only 21 years old.

questions.q: Which palace was home to Ottoman sultans for nearly four centuries?
questions.say: Which palace was home to Ottoman sultans for nearly four centuries?
questions.fact: Topkapı Palace became a museum in 1924.
questions.sayAnswer: Top-kapuh Palace! It became a museum in 1924.

questions.q: Who was the great architect of Istanbul's Süleymaniye Mosque?
questions.say: Who was the great architect of Istanbul's Sue-lay-mah-nee-yeh Mosque?
questions.fact: Sinan also built the Selimiye Mosque in Edirne, a UNESCO site.
questions.sayAnswer: Mee-mar See-nan! He also built the Selimiye Mosque in Eh-deer-neh, a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which Ottoman sultan reigned the longest?
questions.say: Which Ottoman sultan reigned the longest?
questions.fact: Suleiman the Magnificent ruled for 46 years, from 1520 to 1566.
questions.sayAnswer: Suleiman the Magnificent! He ruled for 46 years, from 1520 to 1566.

questions.q: Which city was the Ottoman capital just before Istanbul?
questions.say: Which city was the Ottoman capital just before Istanbul?
questions.fact: Many guess Bursa, but Edirne was the capital until the 1450s.
questions.sayAnswer: Eh-deer-neh! Many people guess Bursa, but Eh-deer-neh was the capital until the 1450s.
